correction_reason: Candidate1 preserves gait and character but bakes muzzle flashes and has insufficient muzzle margin.

params.prompt:
Make only this precise cleanup to this complete VIYA running-and-aiming video. Retain the exact character, original costume, original rifle design, face, camera, root, hair, cloth, source-time gait, feet, body size, full-body framing and every lower-body pose.

1. REMOVE EVERY visible muzzle flash, yellow flare, spark, projectile, smoke, glow cast by a shot and all firing visual effects throughout the entire video. The green background immediately around and in front of the barrel must be clean uniform green on EVERY frame. No firing effects whatsoever, even momentarily. Keep the original red rune detail inside the rifle; do not remove that design detail. The game supplies its own muzzle flash and projectiles.
2. Keep her new firm two-handed aiming posture and subtle mechanical shoulder/rifle recoil. Seat the buttstock snugly at her shoulder and keep the ORIGINAL slim rifle at its exact original physical scale. Pull only the two-handed rifle hold slightly closer into her shoulder so the muzzle tip remains at least 20 pixels inside the RIGHT edge of this 720-pixel-wide source frame throughout. Preserve the entire original barrel and muzzle; do not shorten, redesign or crop the weapon. Natural intact arms/hands must follow the closer hold. Do not move, shrink or reframe her body or the legs.
3. Every lower-body pose, foot contact, hip/root position and gait timing must match this input video exactly. Preserve original bare upper thigh regions, straps and tall decorated boots. Preserve the seam and the last distinct pose leading naturally to the first, with no duplicate closing pose. No frozen legs, ping-pong, ghosted blends, cutout assembly, body warping, camera movement, floor/shadow, text or scenery.

This is a full-frame video edit for a sprite game, not a redesign. Retain the existing painted dark-fantasy anime detail. Silent, uniform green background, complete original character in every frame.
